panel-7-alt.notes: ALT chart -- NOT a live plate. Fiscal stance long-history view (1980-present, annual). Source: IMF World Economic Outlook DataMapper API. SCOPE CAVEAT: both series are general government (federal + provincial + local + social-security), not federal-only. Primary = net lending/borrowing % GDP (negative = deficit). Secondary = gross debt % GDP (NOT net debt; IMF does not publish Canada net debt; label must say 'gross' in any chart caption). WEO vintages include IMF forward projections; chart-builder should visually distinguish projected years (from current year onward). For federal-only framing, DoF Fiscal Reference Tables (PDF annual) are the authoritative source -- extraction deferred to v1.5.
